sections.title: Reading & Listening — Homes around the world

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which shows: a mud hut? / a chalet? / a block of flats? / a farmhouse? / a houseboat?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi birida nima ko'rsatilgan?
exercises.explanationUz:
DUNYODAGI TURLI UYLAR:

  mud hut       — loydan qurilgan kulba (Afrika)
  chalet        — yog'och tog' uyi (Shveytsariya, Alp tog'lari)
  block of flats — ko'p qavatli turar joy binosi
  farmhouse     — ferma uyi
  houseboat     — uy-qayiq (kanal yoki daryoda yashaydigan qayiq)

Har bir uy turi o'sha yerning IQLIMI va TURMUSHIga moslashgan:
  Afrikada issiq — loy devor salqin saqlaydi
  Alp tog'larida sovuq — yog'och issiqni ushlab turadi
  Gollandiyada kanal ko'p — qayiqda yashash odatiy

answers.descEn: Picture 1 — red wooden farm buildings on green grass
answers.descUz: 1-rasm: yashil o't ustidagi qizil yog'och ferma binolari

answers.descEn: Picture 2 — a tall city building with many identical windows
answers.descUz: 2-rasm: ko'p bir xil derazali baland shahar binosi

answers.descEn: Picture 3 — round earth houses with grass roofs in a dry village
answers.descUz: 3-rasm: quruq qishloqdagi somon tomli loy uylar

answers.descEn: Picture 4 — a wooden mountain house with flowers on the balcony
answers.descUz: 4-rasm: balkonida gullari bor yog'och tog' uyi

answers.descEn: Picture 5 — a long narrow red and green boat on a canal

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the people's names to their homes. Write S for Salif, M for Maria, G for Greg, P for Paul and H for Hendrick.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va odamlarning ismini uylariga moslang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Javoblarni 15c matnlaridan ham topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
Beshta odam, beshta uy:
  S = Salif      (Nigeriya)
  M = Maria      (Shveytsariya)
  G = Greg       (AQSh, Boston)
  P = Paul       (Kanada)
  H = Hendrick   (Gollandiya)

Matnlarni o'qib, kim qayerda yashashini toping.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts and fill in the missing prepositions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni o'qing va tushib qolgan predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
JOY PREDLOGLARI — eng chalkash qism.

IN — ichida bo'lgan, o'ralgan joy:
  in a village, in Nigeria, in a mud hut, in a flat,
  in a farmhouse, in the centre, in the area

ON — yuzada, ustida:
  on a mountain (tog' YUZASIDA)
  on the fifteenth floor (qavat YUZASIDA)
  on a farm (ferma YERIDA)
  on a houseboat (qayiq USTIDA)
  on a river (daryo YUZASIDA)

AT — aniq NUQTA, ayniqsa to'liq manzil:
  at 332, Newbury Street

ESLAB QOLING:
  live IN a house / a flat  — uy ichida yashaydi
  live ON a farm            — ferma bir hudud, uning ustida
  live AT + uy raqami       — aniq nuqta

Mamlakat, shahar, qishloq — doim IN.

lines.textEn: Salif lives ____ a village ____ Nigeria.
lines.whyUz: Qishloq va mamlakat — ikkalasi ham IN.

lines.textEn: He lives ____ a mud hut.
Mud huts have got grass roofs. They have usually got only one room.
lines.uz: Loy kulbalarning tomi somondan. Odatda faqat bitta xonasi bo'ladi.

lines.textEn: Maria lives in a chalet ____ a mountain ____ Switzerland.
lines.whyUz: Tog' — YUZA, shuning uchun ON a mountain. Mamlakat — IN Switzerland.

lines.textEn: These houses are made of wood. They have usually got two floors and an attic.
lines.uz: Bu uylar yog'ochdan qurilgan. Odatda ikki qavat va chordog'i bo'ladi.

lines.textEn: Greg lives ____ a huge block of flats ____ Boston.
lines.uz: Greg Bostondagi ulkan ko'p qavatli uyda yashaydi.

lines.textEn: His flat is ____ the fifteenth floor and it is in the centre of the city.
lines.uz: Uning kvartirasi o'n beshinchi qavatda, shahar markazida.
lines.whyUz: Qavat uchun doim ON: on the first/fifteenth floor.

lines.textEn: He lives ____ 332, Newbury Street.
lines.whyUz: To'liq manzil (uy raqami bilan) — AT. Faqat ko'cha nomi bo'lsa — IN Newbury Street.

lines.textEn: There are a lot of expensive shops ____ the area.
lines.uz: Bu hududda ko'p qimmat do'konlar bor.

lines.textEn: Paul lives ____ a farm ____ Canada.
lines.whyUz: Ferma — yer maydoni, ustida yashaydi → ON a farm. Mamlakat — IN.

lines.textEn: He lives ____ a big farmhouse near a river.
lines.uz: U daryo yonidagi katta ferma uyida yashaydi.

lines.textEn: Hendrick lives ____ a houseboat ____ a river in Holland.
lines.uz: Hendrik Gollandiyadagi daryoda turgan uy-qayiqda yashaydi.
lines.whyUz: Qayiq USTIDA — ON a boat. Daryo YUZASIDA — ON a river.

lines.textEn: It's got three cabins.

exercises.instructionEn: Sandra Richway is talking to an estate agent. Read the dialogue and try to fill in the missing information. Listen to the cassette and check your answers. Finally, in pairs, read the dialogue aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Sandra Richway ko'chmas mulk agenti bilan gaplashmoqda. Dialogni o'qing va tushib qolgan savollarni to'ldiring.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor — javoblarni tekshirish uchun. Javoblar dialogning mantiqidan ham topiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
ESTATE AGENT — ko'chmas mulk agenti (uy sotish/ijaraga berish bilan shug'ullanadi).

Bu dialogda 5 ta savol tushib qolgan. Har birida KEYINGI javobga qarang —
u qanday savol berilganini ko'rsatadi:

  javob 'Yes. I want to rent a flat' → savol taklif bo'lgan
  javob 'It has got ... six rooms' → savol xonalar SONI haqida
  javob 'It's 14, Oakfield View'  → savol MANZIL haqida
  javob 'Yes, it's O-A-K-...'     → savol HARFLAB AYTISH haqida
  javob 'Of course. I can take you there' → savol KO'RISH haqida

A = estate agent (agent), S = Sandra

lines.hintUz: Agent mijozni ko'rib, xizmat taklif qiladi
lines.whyUz: Do'kon va xizmat joylarida standart salomlashish. 'May I help you?' ham bo'ladi.

lines.textEn: Yes. I want to rent a flat in this area.
lines.uz: Ha. Men shu hududda kvartira ijaraga olmoqchiman.

lines.textEn: Okay, let me see. There is a very nice flat for rent quite near the city centre.
lines.uz: Xo'p, ko'ray-chi. Shahar markaziga ancha yaqin juda yaxshi ijaraga beriladigan kvartira bor.

lines.textEn: 2) ____ rooms has it got?
lines.whyUz: Sanaladigan narsa soni uchun 'How many'. Sanalmaydigan uchun 'How much'.

lines.textEn: It has got a living-room, dining-room, kitchen, bathroom and two bedrooms. So that's six rooms.
lines.uz: Unda mehmonxona, ovqatlanish xonasi, oshxona, hammom va ikkita yotoqxona bor. Ya'ni oltita xona.

lines.textEn: And how much is it?
It's quite a good price — £300 per month.
That sounds perfect. 3) ____ ?
lines.hintUz: Keyingi javob — uy raqami va ko'cha nomi
lines.whyUz: Javob '14, Oakfield View' — manzil, demak savol manzil haqida.

lines.textEn: It's 14, Oakfield View.

lines.whyUz: Javob 'Yes, it's O-A-K-F-I-E-L-D...' — harflar, demak savol harflab aytish haqida.

lines.textEn: Yes, it's O - A - K - F - I - E - L - D ... V - I - E - W.
5) ____ see it?
lines.hintUz: Ruxsat so'ralyapti — ikki so'z, 'see' dan oldin
lines.whyUz: Javob 'Of course. I can take you there right now' — ruxsat so'ralgan. 'Can I come and see it?' ham to'g'ri.

lines.textEn: Of course. I can take you there right now. Have you got time?
lines.uz: Albatta. Sizni hozir o'sha yerga olib bora olaman. Vaqtingiz bormi?

lines.textEn: Yes. That's great.
Okay. I've got the keys here, so let's go.

exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL SO'RASH — kundalik hayotda eng kerakli dialoglardan biri.

TELEFON RAQAMI ingliz tilida RAQAMMA-RAQAM o'qiladi:
  4204188 → 'four two oh four one double eight'

  0 — 'oh' deb o'qiladi (zero emas!)
  ikkita bir xil raqam ketma-ket → 'double': 88 = 'double eight'
  uchta bir xil → 'triple': 888 = 'triple eight'

MANZIL tartibi: uy raqami, ko'cha nomi, shahar
  14, Milcote Road, Birmingham

KO'CHA turlari:
  Road (Rd)   — yo'l
  Street (St) — ko'cha
  Avenue (Ave) — keng ko'cha (daraxtli)
  Lane        — tor ko'cha
  View        — manzarali ko'cha

example.speaker: A
example.en: Can you spell the street name, please?

example.speaker: B
example.en: M - I - L - C - O - T - E.

example.speaker: A
example.en: Thank you. Have you got a telephone number?

exercises.instructionEn: Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda quyidagi ma'lumotlar bilan shunday dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchta manzil berilgan. Har biri uchun namunadagi dialogni takrorlang:

  • 12, Longhurst Lane, Reading (Tel.: 535602)
  • 17, Morrison Avenue, Bath (Tel.: 334598)
  • 21, Primrose Street, Crewe (Tel.: 750559)

Har bir manzilda 3 ta javob kerak:
  1) manzilning o'zi
  2) ko'cha nomining harflari
  3) telefon raqami — raqamma-raqam

Telefon o'qilishi:
  535602 — five three five six oh two
  334598 — double three four five nine eight
  750559 — seven five oh double five nine

items.textEn: What's your address, please? (12 / Longhurst Lane / Reading)
items.whyUz: Tartib: uy raqami, ko'cha, shahar. Vergul bilan ajratiladi.

items.textEn: Can you spell the street name, please? (Longhurst)
items.answer: L - O - N - G - H - U - R - S - T

items.textEn: Have you got a telephone number? (535602)
items.whyUz: O'qilishi: five three five six oh two.

items.textEn: What's your address, please? (17 / Morrison Avenue / Bath)
Can you spell the street name, please? (Morrison)
items.answer: M - O - R - R - I - S - O - N
items.whyUz: Ikkita R ketma-ket — 'double R' deb ham aytish mumkin.

items.textEn: Have you got a telephone number? (334598)
items.whyUz: O'qilishi: double three four five nine eight.

items.textEn: What's your address, please? (21 / Primrose Street / Crewe)
Can you spell the street name, please? (Primrose)
items.answer: P - R - I - M - R - O - S - E

items.textEn: Have you got a telephone number? (750559)
items.whyUz: O'qilishi: seven five oh double five nine.

groups.ruleUz: Qo'shma so'z bilan yasalgan uy turlari
groups.explanationUz: Uy turi ko'pincha MATERIAL yoki JOY + uy so'zidan yasaladi.

items.note: fransuz tilidan; o'qilishi 'SHA-ley', oxirgi t o'qilmaydi

groups.explanationUz: Narsa nimadan yasalganini aytish uchun 'be made of' ishlatiladi.
Qavat raqami TARTIB SON bilan aytiladi va oldiga 'the' qo'yiladi.
Manzil yozganda ko'cha turi qisqartiriladi va nuqta qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Qayerda yashashini aytish va manzil so'rash.

patterns.exampleEn: Salif lives in a village in Nigeria. He lives in a mud hut.
patterns.exampleUz: Salif Nigeriyadagi qishloqda yashaydi. U loy kulbada yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ichida bo'lgan, chegarasi bor joy uchun IN.
Qishloq, shahar, mamlakat, uy, kvartira — hammasi IN.

patterns.exampleEn: Maria lives in a chalet on a mountain. Paul lives on a farm.
patterns.exampleUz: Mariya tog'dagi chaletda yashaydi. Pol fermada yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Yuza yoki maydon uchun ON: on a mountain, on a farm,
on a houseboat, on a river, on the fifteenth floor.

patterns.formula: somebody lives AT + uy raqami, ko'cha.
patterns.explanationUz:
To'liq manzil (uy raqami bilan) — AT.
Faqat ko'cha nomi bo'lsa — IN Newbury Street.

patterns.formula: What's your address, please? — uy raqami, ko'cha, shahar.
patterns.exampleEn: What's your address, please? — 14, Milcote Road, Birmingham.
patterns.explanationUz: 'please' so'zi savolni muloyim qiladi — inglizchada juda muhim.

patterns.formula: Can you spell ... , please? — harflab aytish.
patterns.exampleEn: Can you spell the street name, please? — M-I-L-C-O-T-E.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'cha nomini harflab ayta olasizmi? — M-I-L-C-O-T-E.
patterns.explanationUz:
'spell' — so'zni harflab aytmoq. Telefonda va rasmiy joylarda
doim so'raladi, chunki ingliz tilida yozilishi va o'qilishi farq qiladi.

patterns.formula: Have you got a telephone number? — Yes. It's + raqamlar.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you got a telephone number? — Yes. It's 4204188.
patterns.explanationUz: Raqamlar birma-bir o'qiladi. 0 — 'oh', ikkita bir xil — 'double'.

patterns.formula: How many + ko'plik ot + has it got?
patterns.exampleEn: How many rooms has it got?
patterns.explanationUz:
Sanaladigan narsalar uchun 'How many'.
Pul va sanalmaydigan narsalar uchun 'How much': How much is it?
